## The Vibe Coding & AI Philosophy
Atəş Balıyev redefines modern development: instead of archaic manual syntax writing, he builds sophisticated systems through "Vibe Coding", multi-agent LLM systems, low-code/no-code platforms, and n8n autonomous workflows. This methodology enables unprecedented development velocity, reducing deployment cycles from months to hours while maintaining enterprise robustness.
